title: I LOVE FINCH
body:
I love Finch! This app is genuinely my saver and it's the only thing that helps me to get up and eat from when it gets harsh for me :) Also perfect for my hygiene routine. I struggled my whole life with brushing my teeth and only the feature of gaining micropets through goals helped me to be consistent with it! Also the events are super cool, I love decorating a room for my birdie and I love buying new clothes for her. And I love micropets especially they are so pretty and cute 😭 The fact that this app is still developing and devs are adding new cool staff all the time is amazing too! My favourite new thing is hair! 

Great app, 10/10, recommend with all my heart! ❤️ I have a 326 days streak :)
author: Katya !

title: Awesome!!
body:
This app is very useful!! Usually I do not interact with ads, but this one literally caught my eye, so I decided to download it.
You can find a huge variety of features in it, I mean HUGE, I probably don’t know even all of them😭  and every single one is helpful!! Throughout my experience, I can feel that the developers really care and love their app, there are so many small things that just show how much they want to help those in need. 
And I was surprised that the app is mostly free! 
I can’t even describe how I love Finch. I’ve already invited two friends and they invited theirs, I really hope that developers will receive the recognition and the support they deserve 🌷

title: Love this app<3
body: This app really helps people with or after depression, people with apathy, people who struggles to do the "simple" things, chores, that other people do on a daily basis. Thank you for creating this app. I finally started a "normal" life i always wanted, making my bed, brushing my teeth every day, taking a shower, cleaning my house, cat's litter box, not forgetting to take my medication, because for people with mental illnesses all this might be so much harder to do than to others. Thank you again!
author: Mokimora

title: absolutely recommend
body:
at first i wasn't sure that this app will do its job, as i am always sceptic about apps that intend to help people with their self care. however, even though there are some self care apps that are useless, Finch is not the case
my birb, Pie, helped me a lot during these 3 harsh months — she always reminds me that i deserve being kind to myself and that i will achieve my goals. Pie is a cutie and it's fun to talk to her when she discovers something new about the world. every day i'm so excited about completing my daily goals because Pie cheers me up and it keeps me motivated to continue my journey. i'm thankful to Pie and the creators of Finch
i totally recommend Finch to anyone, although the system might be confusing at first (i couldn't figure out what are energy points and rainbow stones and what are the differences between them). if you seek for a habit tracking app, want someone to cheer you up, and adore cute things, you definitely should give Finch a try
